row.title: Delete a duplicate account
row.note: kept the duplicate's contact and deal

final_reply:
ACME Inc. is gone. I merged it into Acme Corp instead of deleting it outright, because a plain delete would have lost the records attached to it.

ACME Inc. had:
- **A contact:** Lisa Hart, Operations Director (lhart@acme.com)
- **A Closed Won opportunity:** ACME - Spare Parts 2025, $9,500, sales rep Dana

Both now sit under Acme Corp. ACME Inc.'s own fields only had the same website, phone, industry and state written differently, so nothing else was lost.

There's also an account called **Acme Corporation** (001g8000015BWpDAAW). It has the same website, phone number, industry and state, so it's probably another duplicate of Acme Corp. Do you want me to merge it too? I didn't touch Acme Plumbing, which is a separate company in Wisconsin.
